001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
005import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
006
007/**
008 * Thread-safe registration. If a slot is already used by a built-in item of that layout, the addon item is skipped
009 * and the core logs one warning per id. Addon items cannot be dropped or moved, the same as built-in items.
010 */
011public interface HotbarItemRegistry {
012
013    /**
014     * Register a hotbar item.
015     * @param owner The plugin that owns the item
016     * @param item The item
017     * @throws IllegalArgumentException if the id is already registered or invalid, or the slot is out of 0-35.
018     */
019    void register(Plugin owner, HotbarItem item);
020
021    /**
022     * Unregisters and removes the item from every online player currently holding it.
023     * @param id The item id
024     * @return true if an item with this id was registered
025     */
026    boolean unregister(String id);
027
028    /**
029     * Unregister every item of a plugin.
030     * Called automatically by the core when {@code owner} is disabled.
031     * @param owner The plugin
032     */
033    void unregisterAll(Plugin owner);
034
035    /**
036     * Re-applies addon items of the player's current layout: gives missing ones, removes ones whose getItem now
037     * returns null. Main thread only.
038     * @param player The player
039     */
040    void refresh(Player player);
041
042    /**
043     * Get the addon item id of an item stack.
044     * @param itemStack The item stack, nullable
045     * @return the registered id of an addon hotbar item, or null if the stack is not one.
046     */
047    String getItemId(ItemStack itemStack);
048
049}
